longshotsPolicy.publicNote: Only runners available or forecast at 20/1+ qualify. Each-way appeal is about the chance of outrunning the price and reaching the places; it is separate from the main win-confidence selections.
longshotsPolicy.priceRule: If the price contracts below 20/1, the horse no longer qualifies for this tab.

longshotsToday.reason: Improved from eighth to third at Wolverhampton and now gets 8st13lb from a low draw. Her RPR66 puts her much closer to the experienced second tier of this maiden than a 20/1+ quote suggests, while Jennie Candlish is operating well enough to make the profile credible.
longshotsToday.risk: Dorigo sets a very high standard and Eagle Storm was well held by the first two last time; this is primarily a place-value case.

longshotsToday.terms: 13-runner beginners chase; check bookmaker place terms
longshotsToday.reason: A Gordon Elliott runner ridden by Jack Kennedy at 20/1 deserves more respect than the bare recent form suggests. He has an OR90/TS82/RPR89 base and a prior distance win, giving him established ability in a race containing several runners with very limited chase evidence.
longshotsToday.risk: Recent form 5-5-7-0 is weak and he has to prove the switch to fences unlocks improvement.

longshotsToday.terms: Large-field handicap; take only if 20/1+ remains available
longshotsToday.reason: First handicap, a 3lb claim and RPR75 against OR69 create an unexposed handicap profile at a big price. Gavin Cromwell is exactly the type of trainer whose placement deserves attention when a horse changes race conditions or code.
longshotsToday.risk: TS31 is weak and her recent 2-8-0 form leaves plenty to prove at two miles.

longshotsToday.reason: A debutant with a pedigree that makes today's mile plausible: by Without Parole, out of a dam who won around a mile, and a half-brother won from 6f to roughly 7½f. Draw 2 is useful and the 25/1 price allows for the obvious lack of race experience.
longshotsToday.risk: Jonathan Portman's yard was 0-16 with 2yo newcomers this season in the available pre-race data, so this is pedigree-led rather than trainer-debut confidence.

midshotsPolicy.publicNote: 10/1–18/1 runners with a credible win route and enough place appeal for each-way protection. This band is more win-focused than the 20/1+ longshots page.
midshotsPolicy.priceRule: Only keep a horse here while a best available price remains between 10/1 and 18/1.

midshotsToday.reason: The strongest ratings-versus-price profile in this band. RPR91 sits 24lb above OR67, his last two runs have been much better than the earlier form for Ben Haslam, and he was third at Newcastle last time. Low weight and stall 2 add to a live 7f handicap profile.
midshotsToday.risk: This is a deeper Class 4 than his latest run and Nostrum/Not That Guy set a much stronger market standard.

midshotsToday.reason: A proven 7f horse who was better than the bare sixth at Carlisle after being set plenty to do. Warren Fentiman's 3lb claim helps and the price has drifted to the top of the mid-shot range despite his course/distance credentials.
midshotsToday.risk: Heavy ground is a stronger test than the latest run and Empirestateofmind is a powerful favourite.

midshotsToday.reason: She was runner-up in a higher grade over a mile on soft ground in June and has continued to fall in the weights. Back on turf with a useful 3lb claimer, the current 12/1–14/1 quote is much shorter than the old forecast but still offers a plausible win and place route.
midshotsToday.risk: Her recent form is inconsistent and she needs to bounce back from a moderate Newcastle run.

midshotsToday.terms: 8 runners; standard place terms usually 3 places only if bookmaker offers
midshotsToday.reason: A fair Flat winner now down the weights over hurdles, with blinkers reapplied. The live price ranges from about 12/1 to 16/1, giving a much better risk/reward profile than the short end of this race if the headgear sparks a return to his Flat-level ability.
midshotsToday.risk: His hurdle form for the current yard has been weak and recent stable form is not a positive.

midshotsToday.terms: 6 runners; each-way terms may be only 2 places
midshotsToday.reason: Brian Hughes is booked for the chase debut of a lightly raced five-year-old who once finished second in a junior hurdle. He gets 13lb from the top pair and is Sporting Life's third choice behind the two obvious principals.
midshotsToday.risk: No chase evidence and his handicap-hurdle form last season was poor; the race also has limited each-way places.

midshotsToday.reason: She beat Parikarma by 4½ lengths over roughly three miles on good ground in June and is back on that winning mark. RPR108 against OR97 leaves a healthy ratings cushion, while today's trip/ground are close to the conditions of that success.
midshotsToday.risk: She folded badly last time and some bookmakers are shorter than 10/1, so she only belongs here if 10/1+ remains available.
